title: Twenty-eight flyers
logline: The Crab Derby: twenty-eight on the wall, the girl fifteen and taller than the row, pinning without reaching. The page draws her whole — the second full figure in Vol. II is Gully's daughter.

panels.composition: The shingle wall with twenty-eight flyers, and a fifteen-year-old girl in her father's apron pinning the newest at eye level without reaching, drawn whole, the dock behind her.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a shingle wall with a row of twenty-eight crab flyers and a fifteen-year-old girl in an oversized apron pinning the newest at eye level, drawn whole, a dock behind, no words legible
image.notes: The second full figure in the private pages (after Gully, ro_2024-08-04).

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
